spans.s: रशना f. 1. A rope, a cord; 2. a rein, a bridle; 3. a girdle, a woman’s zone, कस्याश्चिदासीद्रशना तदानीमंगुष्टमूलार्पितसूत्रशेषा R.vii.10; 4. the tongue, the sense of taste, Bh.V.i.111.
रशना f. 1. A rope, a cord; 2. a rein, a bridle; 3. a girdle, a woman’s zone, कस्याश्चिदासीद्रशना तदानीमंगुष्टमूलार्पितसूत्रशेषा R.vii.10; 4. the tongue, the sense of taste, Bh.V.i.111.
रसना f. 1. The tongue, सोऽपूर्वो रसनाविपर्ययविधिस्तत्कर्नयोश्चापलम् K.Pr.x.; 2. a zone, a woman’s girdle, रसतु रसनापि तव घनजघनमण्डले Git.G.x.

रसन n. 1. Crying, roaring, sound, noise; 2. rumbling of clouds, thunder; 3. taste, flavour, सन्धिः शबलता चेति सर्वेपि रसनाद्रसाः S.D.iii.; 4. the organ of taste, the tongue, श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च Bg.xv.9; 5. a perception, apprehension, sense.
रशना-उपमा f. a series of comparisons in which the Upameya in the first comparison is the Upamāna in the second and so on, S.D.x.(654).
रशना-उपमा f. a series of comparisons in which the Upameya in the first comparison is the Upamāna in the second and so on, S.D.x.(654).
रश्मि m. 1. A string, a rope; 2. a bridle, a rein, मुक्तेषु रश्मिषु निरायतपूर्वकायाः Sak.i.; 3. a whip; 4. a beam, a ray of light, Na.xxii.56.
रश्मि-कलाप m. a pearl-necklace of fifty-four strings.
रश्मि-मत् m. the sun.

रस् (I) vi. 1P (pp. रसित; pres. रसति) 1. To roar, to cry, करीव वन्यः परुषं ररास R.xvi.78; 2. to tinkle, to sound, to make noise, रसतु रसनापि तव घनजघनमंडले Git.G.x., Sis.xi.70; 3. to resound, to reverberate.
रस् (II) vt. 10U (pres. रसयति-ते) To taste, to relish, Sis.x.27.
रास् vi. 1Ā (pres. रासते) To cry, to make a sound.

रस m. 1. The juice of plants, K.S.i.7; 2. water, सहस्रगुणमुत्स्रष्टुमादत्ते हि रसं रविः R.i.18; 3. liquor, drink, M.ii.177; 4. poison; 5. any mixture, draught, or elixir; 6. an essential fluid of the body; 7. quick-silver; 8. semen; 9. any mineral substance; 10. the essence of any thing; 11. taste, flavour, relish, (considered to be one of the twenty four guṇas in Vaiśeṣika philosophy; the rasas are six in number; See कटु II); 12. sauce, condiment; 13. taste for any thing, desire, इष्टे वस्तुन्युपचितरसा प्रेमराशीभवन्ति Megh.ii.49; 14. love, affection, जरसा यस्मिन्नहार्यो रसः Ut.i.; 15. a poetic sentiment, जयंति ते सुकृतिनो रससिद्धाः कवीश्वराः Bhartr.ii.24; (in works on rhetoric, usually eight sentiments are enumerated, viz., शृंगारहास्यकरुणरौद्रवीरभयानकाः । बीभत्साद्भुतसंज्ञौ चेत्यष्टौ नाट्ये रसाः स्मृताः K.Pr.iv.; but शांत, वात्सल्य and भक्ति are sometimes added to these; Rasa constitutes the essence of poetry in the opinion of most writers on rhetoric); 16. charm, elegance, beauty.
रसा f. 1. The hell, the lower world; 2. the earth, ground, soil, रसासाररसा साररायताक्षक्षताय सा K.Pr.ix.; 3. the tongue.

रास m. 1. Uproar, din, sound in general; 2. a kind of dance danced by cowherds, especially by Kṛṣṇa and the Gopīs of Vṛndāvana, रासरसे सह नृत्यपरा हरिणा युवतिः प्रशशंसे, or रासोल्लासभरेन विभ्रमभृतामाभीरवामभ्रुवाम् Git.G.i.
रस-अम्ल m. sour sauce, tamarind sauce.
रस-अयन n. 1. a medicine prolonging life, an elixir vitæ, कर्णामृतानि मनसश्च रसायनानि Ut.i.; 2. alchemy, chemistry.
रस-अयन˚श्रेष्ठ m. mercury.
रस-आभास m. the semblance or mere appearance of a sentiment, the sentiment when its manifestation is degrading or improper (in rhetoric).
रस-आस्वाद m. the perception of a sentiment in poetry, sense of poetical beauty, e.g. संसारविषवृक्षस्य द्वे एव रसवत्फलैः । काव्यामृतरसास्वादः संगश्च सुजनैः सह.
रस-इंद्र m. 1. mercury; 2. the philosopher’s stone whose touch is supposed to turn iron into gold.
रस-उद्भव, -उपल n. a pearl.
रस-उद्भव, -उपल n. a pearl.
रस-कर्मन् n. preparation of quick-silver.
रस-केसर n. camphor.
रस-गन्ध m.n. gum-myrrh.
रस-ग्रह a. 1. perceiving flavours; 2. appreciating pleasures.
रस-ज (I) m. sugar or molasses.
रस-ज (II) n. blood.
रस-ज्ञ (I) a. one who has enjoyed or knows the taste of, one who appreciates the excellence of, सांसारिकेषु च सुखेषु वयं रसज्ञाः Ut.ii.
रस-ज्ञ (II) m. 1. a poet, a man of taste, a critic; 2. an alchemist, a physician, a preparer of chemical compounds.
रस-ज्ञ (III) n. the tongue.
रस-ज्ञा f. the tongue.
रस-धातु n. quick-silver.
रस-प्रबन्ध m. any poetical composition, especially a drama.
रस-फल m. the cocoanut tree.
रस-भंग m. the interruption or cessation of a sentiment.
रस-राज m. quick-silver.
रस-वत् (I) a. 1. juicy; 2. tasteful, savoury, well-flavoured; 3. moist, well-watered; 4. charming, elegant; 5. possessing love and other sentiments; 6. spirited, witty.
रस-वत् (II) n. a figure in which a subordinate sentiment is employed to heighten the principal one.
रस-वती f. a kitchen.
रस-विक्रय m. the sale of liquors.
रस-शास्त्र n. the science of alchemy.
रस-सिद्धि f. skill in alchemy.
रसना-रद m. a bird.
रसना-लिह् m. a dog.
रसा-तल n. 1. one of the seven hells or regions below the earth; 2. the lower world or hell in general, जातिर्यातु रसातलं गुणगणस्तस्याप्यधो गच्छतु Bhartr.ii.39.
रसाल (I) m. 1. The mango tree, यावन्मिलदलिमालः कोपि रसालः Bh.V.i.7; 2. the sugarcane.
रसाल (II) n. Frankincense, gum-myrrh.
रसाला f. 1. The tongue; 2. a vine or grape; 3. curds mixed with sugar and spices.

रसिक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Savoury, tasteful, flavoured; 2. impassioned, elegant; 3. witty, humorous; 4. apprehending flavour or beauty, appreciative, रसिकजनं तमुतामतिमुदितम् Git.G.vi.; 5. taking pleasure in, delighting in, अन्तर्धानव्यसनरसिका रात्रिकापालिकीयम् K.Pr.x.
रसिक (II) m. 1. A man full of feeling or passion, a libertine; 2. a horse; 3. an elephant.

रसिक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Savoury, tasteful, flavoured; 2. impassioned, elegant; 3. witty, humorous; 4. apprehending flavour or beauty, appreciative, रसिकजनं तमुतामतिमुदितम् Git.G.vi.; 5. taking pleasure in, delighting in, अन्तर्धानव्यसनरसिका रात्रिकापालिकीयम् K.Pr.x.
रसिका f. 1. The juice of sugarcane, molasses; 2. tongue; 3. a woman’s girdle.
रसित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Having flavour or sentiment; 2. gilded, plated with gold.
रसित (II) n. 1. Wine, liquor; 2. a cry, a thunder, a sound, a noise, गम्भीरमेघरसितव्यथिता कदाहम्
Ghat.14
रसित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Having flavour or sentiment; 2. gilded, plated with gold.
रसोन m. A kind of garlic. Cf. लसोन.
रस्य a. (f. स्या) Juicy, savoury, palatable, रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्विकप्रियाः Bg.xvii.8.
रस्य a. (f. स्या) Juicy, savoury, palatable, रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्विकप्रियाः Bg.xvii.8.
राशि m. 1. A heap, a pile, a mass, a multitude, मृदुनि मृगशरीरे पुष्पराशाविवाग्निः Sak.i.; 2. the number or figures put down for an arithmetical calculation; 3. a sign of the zodiac.
राशि-अधिप m. the regent of an astrological house.
राशि-चक्र n. the zodiac.
राशि-त्रय n. the rule of three.
राशि-भाग m. a fraction.
राशि-भाग˚अनुबंध m. the addition of fractions.
राशि-भोग m. the passage of the sun or any planet through a sign of the zodiac.
राष्ट्र (I) n. 1. A kingdom, a realm, राष्ट्रिकैः सह तद्राष्ट्रं क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति M.x.61; 2. a district, a territory, गौडं राष्ट्रमनुत्तमम् Pr.Ch.ii.; 3. people, a nation, M.ix.254.
राष्ट्र (II) m.n. Any public calamity.
राष्ट्रिक m. 1. An inhabitant of a country, a subject, M.x.61; 2. the ruler of a kingdom.
राष्ट्रिय m. 1. the ruler of a territory, a king, एष राष्ट्रियश्यालः कुपितो भणति Mrich.ix.; 2. a queen’s brother (in theatrical language).
रास-क्रीडा f. a sportive dance, the circular dance of Kṛṣṇa and the Gopīs of Vṛndāvana.
रास-मंडल n. a sportive dance, the circular dance of Kṛṣṇa and the Gopīs of Vṛndāvana.
रासक n. A kind of minor drama in one act. See S.
रासभ m. An ass, a donkey.
